findings.message: [run-002 finding 1 / run-001 finding 1: STILL OPEN after three cycles] specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-03.md row U3-08 ('Managing conflict while maintaining professionalism', topic-03.mdx) is still grounded in goe2008. The bundle's own bound excerpt specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/goe2008.md states in its 'What this settles' section: 'Does NOT support Unit 3 coverage row U3-08'. goe2008 is NOT a declared-unretrievable source - it was retrieved at HTTP 200 with a recorded sha256 - so owner ruling D-2026-0001 does not reach it. Prose is clean: topic-03.mdx lines 80-83 present the four-decision-point sequence as 'a workable default' with no citation, so no learner is misled. What changed this cycle: commit 2b4dd11 added goe2008 to topic-03's Further reading (lines 207-210) with the gloss 'on relationships beyond the classroom as a component of effectiveness' - which describes U3-07's subject, not U3-08's, and so does not repair the mapping. REPAIR: re-map U3-08 to a source that addresses conflict handling, or mark the row as practitioner guidance the way topic-04 marks its heuristic in prose.

[run-002 finding 7 / run-001 finding 7: STILL OPEN, and the new declaration does not close it] specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-03.md row U3-12 ('The teacher as change agent and as moral agent') is grounded in suarez2022, and docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/topic-05.mdx lines 71-94 still carry no citation. suarez2022 is now declared under '## Unverifiable sources', but the declaration is INCOMPLETE in the way the amended rubric names: it says 'The U3-12 mapping could not be settled', presenting the mapping as an open question, while the bundle already contains affirmative counter-evidence at specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/suarez2022.md - 'The record's subject is TPI as a construct and a development model. Nothing in it addresses the teacher as change agent or moral agent.' A declaration that reports settled counter-evidence as unsettled understates what it leaves unchecked. Corroborating internal inconsistency: the sources table's own 'Supports' gloss for suarez2022 reads 'professional identity as continuing rather than fixed at qualification, and its support during change', which does not describe U3-12's subject at all, yet the row still claims U3-12. REPAIR: re-map U3-12 to a source that addresses change agency and moral agency, or cite the section properly and narrow suarez2022 to U3-13; and correct the declaration to state that the OpenAlex record contradicts the mapping rather than that the mapping is unsettled.

[run-002 finding 12: STILL OPEN, unrepaired] docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-03/topic-04.mdx line 118 states 'Furlich (2016) surveyed 77 undergraduates at one United States university'; line 206 repeats 'The evidence cited here comes from university students in the United States and Ghana'; the Further reading note at line 255 repeats 'Note the setting: 77 undergraduates at one United States university'. The bound excerpt specs/content/efmp-302/sources/texts/furlich2016.md declares its provenance as the verbatim abstract and states in its own scope note that the abstract does NOT give the sample size and names no country ('a small liberal arts university'). furlich2016 is not declared under '## Unverifiable sources' and the prose discloses no uncorroboration, so this is an unsupported specific claim under the ordinary rule, untouched by D-2026-0001. Aggravating context: the assertion sits inside the paragraph headed 'Read the evidence with its scope attached', in the same topic that teaches learners not to carry a number beyond what its source establishes. The DIRECTION of Furlich's result - verbal immediacy significant, non-verbal not - IS verbatim-supported and is not in question. REPAIR: bind the methods passage that gives N, or drop the figure and the country and keep 'one small liberal arts university', which the abstract supports verbatim.
